title: Version-skew policy - handshake doctor integration and floor behavior
description: WHY: three install scopes mean multiple bwrk versions will coexist on one machine; skew must be visible and bounded, never silent. WHAT: (1) define and document the compatibility contract: which version may operate on which state schemaVersion, what delegation guarantees, and what happens when a newer state file meets an older binary (the existing fail-closed schema rejection stays the hard backstop - packages/storage/src/file-store.ts documentToSnapshot); (2) doctor diagnostics: warn when the machine binary and a repo-pinned version differ by more than a patch, error when a binary meets a state schema it does not support, both with channel-correct upgrade commands using the channel detection from the dist-build task; (3) floor behavior when delegation is unavailable (pinned binary missing because node_modules is not installed): hard typed error naming pnpm install rather than silently running the machine version against the pinned repo; (4) document the policy in docs (getting-started install section plus a short compatibility note in docs/architecture). This task is the safety net that makes the tier system honest.
acceptanceCriteria: Doctor reports skew warnings and schema errors with channel-correct upgrade commands, covered by fixture tests
A pinned repo without installed node_modules produces a typed error naming the install command instead of falling back to the machine binary
